title: Implement grouped provider filtering and atomic claiming
description: Extend provider selection interfaces and flat-file list/preview/claim paths with filters for issueId, project, milestone, version, featureId, and feature. Apply the shared matcher before existing branch-scope, status, dependency, assignee, priority, and age logic; preserve ready/next parity and atomic claims. Cover mixed casing, AND filters, unmatched scopes, branch isolation, dependencies, and concurrency.
